steps: Click `a`; wait 300 ms; screenshot (a selected: the mapping holds); then cmd+c; Right; wait 1200 ms; Right; wait 300 ms; cmd+z; cmd+v; wait 500 ms; then the Edit menu with the mouse: Undo; Escape, then Tab (back from the pasted copy to `a`, the first element of the slide, which a press could not reach: the copy covers it); Copy; Paste; Undo. The spec puts a probe Edit menu in place for the case: the same five items, each noting itself and then doing what the role item does.
note: page px are CSS px from the content’s top-left; on macOS the content sits at the window’s top-left (MAWS hides the title bar), so window points = page px at zoom 1. Calibrate cua’s coordinate space with the L0 step before L1.
